name: estacao-meteorologica
description: Monorepo da Estação Meteorológica (api + web) — scripts agregados

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix api && npm run test:coverage --prefix web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix api && npm run lint --prefix web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix api && npm run lint:fix --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix api && npm run format:check --prefix web
